name: audit-known-project
prompt: I'm in the TaskOwl app directory (~/Gits/TaskOwl-app). Run a context check to see if my AI context is set up correctly for this project.

expected_behaviors.description: Reads ~/.golems/config.yaml to find the project's context profile
Runs the audit.sh script to check context
Reports on MCP server status (blocked vs allowed)
Does NOT list 30+ skills to ignore in output (positive framing only)

name: fix-mode-generates-configs
prompt: I'm in the brainlayer repo (~/Gits/brainlayer). Run context-check in fix mode to generate the right configs for this project.

expected_behaviors.description: Blocks voicelayer and supabase MCPs (per brainlayer profile)
Generates CLAUDE.md containerization section with allowlist
Uses allowlist, not blocklist, for skills

name: unknown-project-discovery
prompt: I'm in a new project directory (~/Gits/some-new-app) that isn't in the golems registry. Check its context setup.

expected_behaviors.description: Recognizes the project is not in the registry
Offers to scan the repo to suggest a profile
Does NOT guess or fabricate a profile for an unknown project

name: token-waste-estimation
prompt: How much context am I wasting on irrelevant skills in the TaskOwl project? Give me the numbers.

expected_behaviors.description: Provides a token count estimate for wasted context
Expresses waste as percentage of context window
Actually runs the audit rather than guessing
